verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for account events. V3 webhooks are set up by creating a webhook subscription, cover incident priority and responder change event types, and offer filtering, which directly delivers subscribing to events via webhooks. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented delivery details such as signature verification and retry behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to receive HTTP callbacks when significant events happen in your PagerDuty account
V3 webhooks are configured by creating a _webhook subscription_ which contains three main components
they provide additional event types to signal changes to incident priorities and incident responders. They also provide additional filtering capabilities.
